defect: logic is present between the first and second destination synchronizer stages
rationale: serial_a is asynchronous to clk_b, and the second receiving stage applies inversion to stage0_b before producing serial_b.
author: gpt-5.6-luna

labels.by: claude-sonnet (blind second labeller, design and constraints only)
labels.note: Only an inverter sits between the two stages; it adds no reconvergence or glitch and does not change metastability resolution, so the 2-flop crossing is still sound.

labels.by: gpt-6.1-sol (separate settling reader, the case and both arguments only)
labels.note: The inverter between the receiving flops breaks the direct stage-to-stage connection a synchroniser needs: its delay eats metastability settling time and lowers MTBF. No MTBF qualification is supplied.

provenance.adaptation: Kept the two-register serial sampling shape and edge-oriented output path, reduced the dependency on common_cells macros, and exposed the registers in a self-contained top module.

mutation.description: Changed the second destination stage to capture the inverted first-stage value instead of the first-stage value directly.

settled_by: third reading; verdict bad (2 of 3 readings)
